risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (382.8) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 61 days presents moderate event risk for IT sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9, Supertrend, and Hull momentum signals combined with extreme fear sentiment (21/100) and price near support (108.02) offer contrarian entry for mean reversion in crisis-driven selloff.
